run_generate_changelog: run generate_changelog.py with a previous release tag to list changes per language since that release
review_Language_class: review the Language class that stores a language name and its git pathspec list
refactor_languages_list: refactor the languages list to add or remove protobuf language entries with their pathspecs
summarize_changelog_script: summarize the changelog script that runs git log per language pathspec and formats output with sed
test_generate_changelog_cli: test generate_changelog.py by passing a git tag as the previous release argument
